We need to write a letter to a friend, all lowercase letters, asking them to go and vote. Must be all lowercase. No uppercase letters anywhere. Also no commentary about constraints. So just output the letter in lowercase. Ensure no uppercase letters appear, even at start of sentences. Use only lowercase letters, spaces, punctuation (punctuation is allowed; punctuation does not have case). Must not include any uppercase letters, like "I" must be "i". Also avoid proper nouns capitalized. So we write something like:

"hey friend,

i hope you're doing well. i wanted to remind you that election day is coming up and your vote really matters. please consider going to the polls and casting your ballot. it's a simple way to make your voice heard and help shape our community. let me know if you need any info about polling places or times. thanks for being awesome.

take care,
[your name]"

Make sure all letters are lowercase. Use "i" not "I". Avoid "Hey" capitalized. Use "hey". Ensure no uppercase letters anywhere. Also avoid "Thanks" capitalized. Use "thanks". Also avoid "Take care" capitalized. Use "take care". Also avoid "Election" capitalized. Use "election". Also avoid "Polling" capitalized. Use "polling". Also avoid "Ballot" capitalized. Use "ballot". Also avoid "Community" capitalized. Use "community". Also avoid "Awesome" capitalized. Use "awesome". Also avoid "Thanks" capitalized. Already done. Also avoid "Your". Must be "your". Avoid "You". Use "you". Avoid "It's". That's okay because apostrophe s, but "It's" has capital I? Actually "It's" starts with I capital; we need lowercase: "it's". So change "it's" to "it's". Also "Let me know" -> "let me know". Also "Thanks for being awesome." -> "thanks for being awesome." Also "take care," -> "take care,".

Make sure not to accidentally include uppercase letters like "I" in "i'm"? Actually "i'm" is lowercase i then apostrophe m; that's fine. But "I'm" would be uppercase I. So use "i'm". Also "it's" is fine. Also "don't" is fine. Also "let's" is fine.

take care,
[your name]"
